_comment: ka9q-radio radiod channels over RTP (an RX888, hotairfred/SparkGap#146): radiod does the wideband receiver and the channel filters (radiod_sparkgap.example.conf), SparkGap joins its data group and takes each band's channel by SSRC (its centre in kHz). CW, FT8, RTTY and IQ recording (record_iq_dir) all run from the channels. Copy to <name>.local.json and set callsign, grid and rtp_group.
_comment_rtp_iface: radiod on this computer with ttl = 0: set rtp_iface to 127.0.0.1 or lo (loopback); on another computer: this computer's address or interface name (eth0) on that network, or leave it out
